description: This file defines the BeanManager class within the Api\V8\BeanDecorator namespace. It manages various operations related to SugarBean objects, including creation, retrieval, relationship management, counting records, and filtering fields. It acts as a high-level interface for bean-related interactions, encapsulating behaviors like relationship handling and bean instantiation based on module aliases.

classes.name: BeanManager
classes.description: Manages SugarBean objects, their relationships, and related operations within the application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes BeanManager with a database manager instance and bean alias mappings.

methods.name: newBeanSafe
methods.description: Creates a new SugarBean instance for a given module, considering aliases and validation.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean instance for a specified module and ID.

methods.name: getBeanSafe
methods.description: Securely retrieves a SugarBean by module and ID, throwing exceptions if not found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a BeanListRequest object for the specified module.

methods.name: createRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Creates a relationship between two SugarBeans, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Deletes a relationship between two SugarBeans, with exception handling.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldName
methods.description: Gets the link field name in the source bean for a related bean based on relationship.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldBean
methods.description: Retrieves the bean for a related module via a link field.

methods.name: countRecords
methods.description: Counts records in a module matching a WHERE condition.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns default field names for a given bean.

methods.name: filterAcceptanceFields
methods.description: Filters fields for acceptance, especially for Person beans, excluding relationship info link types.
